claude_proposed_widenings.name: restore_body_part
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Limb regrowth is a mechanical effect with no v4 atom. It is not remove_condition (no condition is being removed), not heal_hp (current HP is unaffected), and not any existing EffectAtom variant. It restores functional anatomy — a distinct category absent from the taxonomy.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you lose a body part, the ring causes the missing part to regrow and return to full functionality after 1d6 + 1 days if you have at least 1 Hit Point the whole time.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_time_interval
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The HP regeneration fires every 10 minutes — a real-time/exploration-time interval not representable by any existing OngoingTrigger variant (passive, on_caster_attack_hit, on_attached_turn_start, on_caster_turn_start, on_attached_damaged, on_creature_moves, on_creature_enters_area). A new trigger variant is needed: { kind: 'on_time_interval'; minutes: number }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you regain 1d6 Hit Points every 10 minutes if you have at least 1 Hit Point

claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics ongoing_effect family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: MagicItemMechanics is PassiveMechanics | ActivatedAbilityMechanics. Neither family can express periodic ongoing operations with triggers and predicates. OngoingEffectMechanics (which has the operations array with trigger+predicate+effect grammar) is spell-only. Magic items with time-interval heal riders require either extending MagicItemMechanics to include an ongoing_effect-like family, or lifting OngoingEffectMechanics to be usable by non-spell units.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you regain 1d6 Hit Points every 10 minutes if you have at least 1 Hit Point.
